نبلاج (form XI)
# نَبْلَاجُّ (nablājju) /nab.laːd͡ʒ.d͡ʒu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِبْلَاجَّ (iblājja)
# نَبْلَاجَّ (nablājja) /nab.laːd͡ʒ.d͡ʒa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِبْلَاجَّ (iblājja)
# نَبْلَاجِّ (nablājji) /nab.laːd͡ʒ.d͡ʒi/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِبْلَاجَّ (iblājja)
